About this item

  • [Ultra-Lightweight Ear Buds Designed for Small Ears] Each earbud weighs only 3.7g and features a compact, ergonomic in-ear design made especially for small ears. Secure, low-profile, and comfortable for workouts, all-day wear or overnight sleeping.The ultra-slim profile sits flush in your ear with no hard edges poking or rubbing, so you can even sleep on your side without discomfort.
  • [Immersive Stereo Sound with TOZO OrigX Technology] TOZO OrigX tuning delivers clear vocals, balanced mids, and natural stereo sound for music, podcasts, and videos.
  • [Long Battery Life for Daily Use] Get up to 7 hours of playtime on a single charge, with up to 32 hours total using the charging case—ideal for workdays, commuting, and extended listening sessions.
  • [Bluetooth 5.3 & Stable Connection] Bluetooth 5.3 provides fast pairing, stable wireless performance, and reduced dropouts as you move around home or office.
  • [Deep Bass with Clear Vocals] High-performance drivers produce punchy bass while keeping vocals clean and detailed for everyday listening.
  • [AI-Enhanced ENC for Clear Calls] ENC microphones help reduce background noise like traffic and office sounds, keeping your voice clear on calls and video meetings.
  • [32 Custom EQ with TOZO App] Use the TOZO app to access 32 EQ presets and adjust bass, vocals, or balanced sound to match your preference.
  • [One-Step Pairing & Touch Controls] Open the case to pair automatically. Touch controls let you manage music, calls, and voice assistants with simple taps.
  • [IPX5 Sweat & Splash Resistance] IPX5-rated protection helps withstand sweat and light splashes—ideal for sports, gym and daily activities.
  • [Made for Calls, Fitness & Daily Comfort] Lightweight, secure, and easy to use—built for daily comfort, clear calls, and an easy fit for small ears.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

      I've only been using these earbuds for about two days, so this is definitely an early first impression, but so far I'm surprisingly happy with them. Once they were fully charged, they connected to my phone with no effort at all. I have fairly small ears, and a lot of earbuds end up hurting because they're too large, but I haven't had that issue with these. They fit well and stay comfortable even after wearing them for a few hours at a time.

      The sound quality, volume, and noise canceling have all been great for me. My favorite feature so far is the call quality. I was constantly disconnecting my previous earbuds whenever I got or made a phone call because no one could hear me. I haven't had that problem with these at all. Calls have been clear, and no one has asked me to repeat myself or speak louder.

      I haven't had a chance to really test the battery life yet since I usually charge my devices every night, so it may be a while before I know how long they actually last. The only feature I miss from my previous pair is the digital battery indicator on the charging case. Other than that, especially for the price, these have been an excellent purchase so far.

    • M. Treestump
      5 out of 5 stars
      Wireless - Waterproof - Great Sound - Phone App - Mind Blowingly low price point for this quality!
      Reviewed in the United States on September 9, 2025
      Color: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I had been searching for a decent pair of wireless waterproof earbuds where the battery would play music for at least 4 hours on a full charge. I wasn't going to even consider any pair fitting my needs priced below $40, until my daughter told me about these, saying she really loved them and used them until she lost one of them after only a few weeks of use. So I bought them, and have all positive things to say about them, except for one thing. Here goes:

      PRO's:

      - They come with 4 pair of different sized rubber fitting tips

      - Using the pre-installled earbud tips, I was shocked in surprise that all it took was one quick finger press and they fit snugly and better than any other pair I have ever worn. As opposed to having to fiddle with them, twist and turn with a bit of force to make them stay in position. Not these - perfect instant snug fit that stays in place!

      - near continuous run time playing music or listening to audio books is at least 4 hours! Are you kidding me? For under $15, having 4-5+ hours battery time? Awesome!

      - When you need to keep using them but a battery dies - This is awesome - One side will always run out of battery before the other. When it does, or better, when it gives the 1st of 3 warning beeps that it is getting low, immediately take it out of your ear and put it in the charge case. OMG. It will charge to 80-90% in 20 mins or so! This means, when one starts to die, put it in the charge case, still listening to the other one. When that dies, even if it's 10 or 20 minutes later, put that one in the charge case, and start listening to the other one that you just put in the charge case a few minutes ago. You will find that it will run long enough for the one you just put in the case to charge to get to a full charge! Doing this, you will always be listening to at least one, but after a couple of times swapping them in/out of the charge case, they charge so fast that you will be back listening to BOTH again for another 1-2 hours, as the charge case if fully charged overnight will charge both earbuds at least 2-3 times. This is amazing - I've had to do this trick of using one while charging the other, but never do they charge fast enough to soon be using both again the same day because of such fast charge times compared to long run times. $15!!! This is an exceptional product and rare to have so many great features for pretty much a cost that makes them disposable but they are anything but!!

      - Sound quality! OMG! Really nice deep base response, and nothing missing throughout the mids and highs either!

      - The phone app makes it easy to pick from a huge repository of EQ settings. The phone EQ app isn't just a cheap attempt so they can advertise it as having a 10 band EQ - it is a bonafide 10 band EQ with a 10 DB range (+5 to -5 per each frequency band). You can create as many EQ templates as you like, give them a custom name, save them, even share them. At least 100 or more you can access from other users whose templates show up in the app.

      -Waterproof! I use them working in the yard (sweating profusely) at the gym, and in the shower blasting hot water from the shower head right on them.

      CON's:

      - Just one. As stated, they fit perfectly... until. At some point wearing them for an hour or so, you can feel one starting to get loose - DAMN! There it is on the ground - I hope it didn't break. Whew, it's still fine. It might just be me, but every single day, after wearing them both for at least an hour of a perfect fit - the moment I feel either one starting to loosen up - is when it is falling out. I took Karate, and I;m known for my fast reflexes, but not once so far have I ever been able to stop either one from falling out. Like I said, they fit perfectly, so I don't adjust them. They seem like they never move at all, maybe my ears build up with a thin layer of humidity/sweat, but without notice either one will just pop out faster than I can try to catch it free-falling 6 feet from my head to the ground.

      So it's been several weeks, so each one has jumped without a parachute to a crash landing on the ground every day, so each one roughly 20 6 foot drops, most of which to cement or asphalt. They both still work 100%, so I am just more surprised than upset at this phenomenon. Perhaps I'll attach a string to them, so when one falls out, I will have time to cup the opposite ear, and it will only fall the length of the string and not hit the ground.

      Instead of a string, I'll just buy at least one more pair, probably two, so that whenever one breaks, is lost, no longer lasts long after charging, it will become disposable (unless first try to take it apart and see if I can buy a super small rechargable battery and replace it myself, who knows, just a fun "maybe" thing.

      I completely 100% endorse these earbuds though. Even in the comments, there doesn't appear to be any issue that keeps coming up over and over, a sign of a well-designed product with a rare lifecycle!

      5 out of 5 stars
      Small ear canal fit, all day charged
      Reviewed in the United States on July 25, 2026
      Color: Rose Gold
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I love these earbuds! I’m buying my third pair simply due to use and misplacement.

      Fit: I have small ear canals and jlab and sony earbuds didn’t fit. These come with so many silicon options for your ear. The smallest fit me perfectly! Another bonus is under my snowboard helmet. It truly takes a fingerprint to pause. It has a low profile and when I turn my head, it doesn’t pause from the pressure of the helmet.

      Charge: I love to listen to audiobooks while hiking. My hikes can range up to 15 hours + multi day. I use one earbud at a time so I can tune into nature as well and can listen all day or multiple days when I’m super into the book. And recharge a bud as needed. They are water resistant, listening through rain, and the case has also been dropped in water and still works.

      Online calls: I use these paired with my laptop to record videos for my online courses, make phone calls, or zoom. The earpiece focuses well on my voice and dampens out external noise.

      Noise Cancellation: I also had 2 kids under 2. I relied on the noise cancellation feature during double tantrums to self regulate and be calm for them.

      I can’t recommend these enough for their price point, fit adjustability, charge life, and water resistance!

      5 out of 5 stars
      Love em
      Reviewed in the United States on July 7, 2024

      Update 1 year later: I still love these!! They still work great and connect with no problems. They stay connected even when I go to the other side of my house without my phone. The battery has gone down some to where I now get only about 4-5 hrs before having to charge them.

      I decided a month ago to get another pair of TOZO earbuds with a longer battery life. I got the A-6s. Those worked great but were too big for my ears and wouldn’t stay in place. I apparently have child sized ears! These earbuds fit great and I can wear them all day. There was a sale for a couple days where you could get them cheaper (forget how much), so I now own 4 pairs of these - 2 green, a blue and a black pair!

      Lastly, my initial pair that I bought a year ago was accidentally washed through a whole wash cycle when I forgot them in my pocket. I was so sad cause I thought they would be totally dead. Opened up the case and popped the buds in my ears; and not a hint of anything gone wrong!! They still work perfectly!!

      Original: I got these after returning another brand - this other brand I ended up returning 2 different pairs because they would not turn off and on when you put them into/ took out of their case and they wouldn’t charge! The second set had those problems and wouldn’t sync with my Bluetooth without going through several elaborate steps! I was done!

      I’m used to over the ear headphones and after the other brands issues, I was skeptical on Bluetooth earbuds. I decided to try these mostly because they were cute and the price wasn’t crazy high for something I might not like.

      I actually love these!

      Pros

      They charge well and pretty quickly. They are cute/aesthetic (I got the mint ones). The buds came with a ton of different ear hole covers including several small ones- I have smaller ear holes and these fit well in my ears. The sound is good, and with the app you can choose your EQ. Originally I thought the sound was just ok, but after getting the app and changing my settings, the sound was so much better. The earbuds work like they’re supposed to and turn on and off when you take them out/put them in the case! I’m able to listen with one ear and not worry that the other is wasting battery. On a long trip I was able to do one ear and change ears when that battery got low. I got through the super long trip on one charge! The earbuds fit well and stay in my ears well.

      Cons

      I did have to buy another charging cord; the one it comes with is crazy short and doesn’t reach anywhere near where I can charge things!

      You can’t really lay down with them in (I could do this with my over the ear ones).

      I’m not sure that audiophiles would find the sound up to their standards.

      This one is only a con if you’re like me (autistic) and have days where you like to go out in public but don’t want to interact with anyone! With my over the ear headphones most people wouldn’t bother me when they were on. These earbuds are not that visible to others unless you have your hair up and the person is close and to the side of you! Even then, some people don’t notice!

      Not a con - just something to get used to…

      I had to get used to was the controls on the sides. Mostly because I would pull one earbud out and hold it in my fingers to hear instructions/announcements/etc and I would accidentally change something with the tap controls on the earbud I was holding! Also, when adjusting them you want to make sure you just grab the sides of them and not hit the controls.

      I haven’t tested the range of these or had them in when I’ve been super sweaty yet. I can’t run, so have no idea how they perform when you’re doing that! If I bend over to one side I do have to make sure they don’t fall out of my ear, but I also don’t like putting them in far enough that it feels like it seals the air.

      I highly recommend getting the TOZO app. If just for being able to choose your EQ!

      Here’s a polished Amazon review that sounds genuine without reading like it was written by the earbuds’ marketing department. Humanity has collectively decided every $30 gadget must claim it’s “life-changing,” so this aims for believable instead.

      I wasn’t expecting to be this impressed, especially for the price. These earbuds honestly perform like a much more expensive pair. The noise cancellation does an amazing job blocking out background noise, making it easy to focus on music, podcasts, or calls.

      One of my favorite features is being able to tap the earbuds to skip tracks, pause, or control playback without reaching for my phone. They also come with an app that’s surprisingly useful. You can customize the equalizer, adjust settings, and fine-tune everything to your liking, which is a feature I usually only see on premium earbuds.

      The sound quality is clear with great bass, they’re comfortable enough to wear for hours, and the battery life has been excellent. If you’re looking for high-end features without paying high-end prices, these are definitely worth buying.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Bon prix, bonne qualité globale👍
      Reviewed in France on December 25, 2022
      Color: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      J'utilise ces tozo A1 pour écouter principalement des podcasts sur mon lieu de travail, et j'en suis globalement très satisfait. Ils produisent un bon son, même pour la musique, sans être exceptionnel non plus, mais on ne va pas leur reprocher cela à ce prix. Je ne suis pas un audiophile ,mais je ressens quand-même un petit manque de basses... La réduction de bruit est passive et donc incomparable avec de l'a.n.c... c'est quand-même correcte. Franchement ils font le taff, ils sont très agréables à porter, ne provoquent aucunes douleurs pour ma part... Quelques petits détails quand même, le filtre anti poussière à l'air un peu fragile mais bon, n'oublions pas le prix de vente. Aussi, au bout de quelques jours, le volume du son n'était pas le même d'une oreillette à l'autre, sans doute dû à ce filtre...

      Mais je tiens vraiment à souligner le sérieux et l'excellent travail du service après-vente qui à été à mon écoute et a résolu mon problème de manière efficace et ultra rapide en remplaçant cette paire par une nouvelle... D'une qualité supérieure Svp !! En toute honnêteté, je ne connaissais pas bien la marque Tozo mais je ne peux que vous conseiller de vous orienter vers cette marque très sérieuse et très prometteuse qui prend soin de ses clients !!

    About this Item

    • [Ultra-Lightweight Ear Buds Designed for Small Ears] Each earbud weighs only 3.7g and features a compact, ergonomic in-ear design made especially for small ears. Secure, low-profile, and comfortable for workouts, all-day wear or overnight sleeping.The ultra-slim profile sits flush in your ear with no hard edges poking or rubbing, so you can even sleep on your side without discomfort.
    • [Immersive Stereo Sound with TOZO OrigX Technology] TOZO OrigX tuning delivers clear vocals, balanced mids, and natural stereo sound for music, podcasts, and videos.
    • [Long Battery Life for Daily Use] Get up to 7 hours of playtime on a single charge, with up to 32 hours total using the charging case—ideal for workdays, commuting, and extended listening sessions.
    • [Bluetooth 5.3 & Stable Connection] Bluetooth 5.3 provides fast pairing, stable wireless performance, and reduced dropouts as you move around home or office.
    • [Deep Bass with Clear Vocals] High-performance drivers produce punchy bass while keeping vocals clean and detailed for everyday listening.
    • [AI-Enhanced ENC for Clear Calls] ENC microphones help reduce background noise like traffic and office sounds, keeping your voice clear on calls and video meetings.
    • [32 Custom EQ with TOZO App] Use the TOZO app to access 32 EQ presets and adjust bass, vocals, or balanced sound to match your preference.
    • [One-Step Pairing & Touch Controls] Open the case to pair automatically. Touch controls let you manage music, calls, and voice assistants with simple taps.
    • [IPX5 Sweat & Splash Resistance] IPX5-rated protection helps withstand sweat and light splashes—ideal for sports, gym and daily activities.
    • [Made for Calls, Fitness & Daily Comfort] Lightweight, secure, and easy to use—built for daily comfort, clear calls, and an easy fit for small ears.

    Product Description

    [32 Preset Modes with TOZO App] Connecting to the TOZO app offers access to extra features, which tailoring the sound output to suit your personal preferences. Whether you prefer stronger bass or more balanced sound, these earbuds give you the flexibility to follow your fine-tuned audio.
